resources.string: Off by default. Send barcodes to Open Food Facts to offer names and categories. You confirm each name. Scanning always works without a connection.

If you enable barcode lookup, Usuals sends scanned barcodes directly to Open Food Facts for product names, categories and product details. Your lists and purchase history are never sent. Lookup is off by default.
Product name lookup is off. Enable it to send barcodes to Open Food Facts for names and categories. Your list and history stay on this phone.
Open Food Facts has no name for this barcode. You can name it once and %1$s will remember it.
Product name lookup could not finish. Check your connection and retry, or name the item yourself.
This is a store-specific barcode. Its product name cannot be looked up in Open Food Facts.
